name: sigmoid_gate_mul_broadcast
description: Row-broadcast gated product: x is [num_tokens, hidden] and gate is [num_tokens, 1]. out[t,h] = cast(x[t,h].float() * sigmoid(gate[t,0].float()), x.dtype). Returns a newly allocated tensor of x's shape and dtype and does not mutate inputs. The suites exercise two-dimensional bfloat16 x with a per-row gate.
